reasoning: The application targets elite interior design studios operating with luxury brands. It needs a premium, 'Godly' website feel with deep contrast, glassmorphism, and elegant typography.

typography.headings: var(--bp-font-heading, 'Cormorant Garamond', serif) - used for the main hero text and individual options.
typography.accent: Monospace used for numbering '01', '02' and small uppercase labels to provide technical contrast.

layout.structure: Split-pane cinematic modal. Left pane (40%) is a brand statement/hero with a rotating text block. Right pane (60%) is a curated vertical atelier index.
layout.spacing: Generous paddings (p-14), items have large gaps, reflecting luxury.

interactions.hover: Row hover triggers an ambient glow on the left pane matching the hovered item's accent color. The hovered row subtly brightens and adds a subtle internal gradient.
interactions.entrance: Staggered Framer Motion entrance. Backdrop blurs smoothly, modal scales up and fades in.

image_urls.description: Abstract minimalist dark architecture to serve as a low-opacity background texture for the left pane hero section.

instructions_to_main_agent: The Create Modal is redesigned as a 'WOW' signature brand moment. It uses framer-motion. All data-testids are preserved. The Blueprint theme logic handles all colors. Do not alter the configuration logic in buildCreationOptions().
